label: sound

unstated.what: Persistent history must be global/class-level so a brand-new ReporterList's exit() clears history recorded by other instances (the autouse fixture relies on this).
history values must be stored as lists per key (history["loss"][-1], history["examples/train"] == [10]).
history must support iteration/dict() conversion (__iter__/keys), not just __getitem__ and __call__.

reasons: Almost all behavior is stated in the instruction; the main unstated requirement is that persistent history is shared globally so a fresh instance's exit() clears it, plus minor shape choices (per-key lists, iterable history).

Every tested behavior (weighted averaging, sum/callable reductions, ValueError on bad reduction string, '<key>/<mode>' history keys, add_scalar/add_scalars/flush dispatch, no-op second report, dual indexing of history, artifact forwarding with normalization, warning on unsupported backends, idempotent exit) is stated in the instruction or follows directly from it; the remaining test details are helper/scaffolding calls.

Every hidden-test behavior — method names, signatures, reduction semantics, key naming, history access patterns, warn-on-unsupported, and exit() clearing — is explicitly stated in the instruction or is a direct consequence of it (e.g., dict(reporter.history)/len() follow from history being a mapping keyed by reported keys).
